title: Validate the cells a selected-cell query is not looking for without building them, and resume the per-sheet cursor's chain walk across a document's worksheets
decision: retained, implemented in litchi-xls; the snapshot-scoped form of XLS-8 is frozen as a design and not implemented
code_state: crates/litchi-xls only; no public API, error type, limit, fence or output byte changed; no new unsafe anywhere including tests; no new dependency
reason_codes: XLS-5 of change 0587: CellRecord::parse materialized a String for every Label and a Vec<u8> plus Metadata for every Formula a query framed, and process_cell dropped all but the target; CellRecord::measure runs every check the parse runs and builds nothing, and the parse's own checks are the implementation both paths reach

the census the item asked for first is the reason the change covers all seven single-cell kinds and not only the two that allocate: 54016.xls, the fixture the survey priced drop_in_place<CellRecord> at 2.05% on, carries zero Formula and zero Label records, so that 2.05% is the enum's drop glue and 88-byte moves

the census also found Label effectively extinct (6 records corpus-wide) and Formula concentrated (14,854 records, 11.69% of cell values, 224,754 Rgce bytes, of which 15228.xls carries 175,054), which is why 15228.xls was added to the measured set

XLS-8 of change 0587 and the open limitation of change 0585: a second StreamChainHint dedicated to the worksheet region, with a lifetime disjoint from the shared-string resolver's, removes 6.14% of the multi-sheet corpus's text-extraction chain links and 0.00% of the single-sheet corpus's

change 0585's unmeasured claim that one hint serving both consumers would save nothing is now measured on a third leg: sharing is 1.61% worse than the disjoint pair over the multi-sheet corpus and worse on 16 fixtures, so the claim holds in direction and was overstated in degree

value identity is established by a corpus differential over 67,422 cell records of 124 fixtures including 142 refusals, 0 divergences, plus 32,884 truncation and bit-flip mutations reaching 9,240 refusals with 0 divergences, and by identical text digests on every chain-link leg of 119 fixtures

accepted_evidence.census: docs/performance/results/change-0641/probe/cell_record_census.py over all 126 .xls/.xlt fixtures: 372 worksheet substreams, 106,689 records, 127,072 cell values, per kind and per sheet; reproduces the survey's 37,929 records for 54016.xls exactly
accepted_evidence.counts: xls_source_attribution, 16 scenarios, 5 samples each, both legs: read calls, read bytes, version() calls and the harness observation identical in all 16 cells
accepted_evidence.chain_links: one instrumented build with three runtime switches (base / hint / shared), full text over every .xls and .xlt fixture, plus one-cell and all-cells on four fixtures; open links identical on all three legs and reproducing change 0585's recorded 2,099 for ConditionalFormattingSamples.xls
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind isolation pairs at 2 and 12 harness samples, differenced and divided by 10, per leg, whole-process totals and per-symbol self cost, over 8 scenarios
accepted_evidence.cycles: perf stat isolation pairs at 20 and 120 samples, -r 5, median of five repetitions per leg pinned to CPU 24, with a third before-binary leg giving the A/A floor for the metric in the same window, over 11 scenarios
accepted_evidence.timing: xls_source_attribution elapsed_samples_ns, order A1 B1 B2 A2 A3 on CPU 24 repeated as interleaved rounds and pooled per leg, in two windows: window 2 (the reported one) at host load 6.2 with 60 samples per leg over all 11 scenarios, and window 1 at host load 11-30 retained in full as the confirming window; every row agrees in sign between the windows and the largest disagreement in magnitude is 2.0 percentage points
accepted_evidence.differential_oracle: crates/litchi-xls/src/records.rs cell_measure_tests: every substream of every fixture framed by hand, both paths run over every cell record of all seven kinds; plus 12 mutations applied to the merged tree with the suites re-run

accepted_costs.full_text_regression: 15228.xls full text is +0.84% in cycles, +0.14% in instructions and +0.28%/+1.24% at p50 against an A/A floor of -0.03%; splitting parse_record_with around frame_record made LLVM outline the CellRecord drop glue that had been inlined into its callers, 412,197 instructions moving into a shared symbol against the 399,641 the chain hint removes from the two chain symbols; its p95 and p99 fall in both windows
accepted_costs.inline_attributes: three #[inline] attributes are load-bearing; the first measurement, taken without them, showed frame_record out of line costing +595,720 instructions per 15228.xls text extraction and turning the whole-sheet walk from -0.35% into +0.95%. #[inline(always)] was measured as an alternative and rejected: it helps full text and hurts the whole-sheet walk
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind counts rep movsb per byte (0604 measured a 35x overstatement), so the memcpy figures are upper bounds and the native cycles are what price them
accepted_costs.chain_links_are_not_latency: a chain link is a dependent load, not a time; change 0585's caveat applies unchanged
accepted_costs.host_load: host quiescence is not established; window 1 was taken at load 11-30 with a measured p50 A/A floor of +-2.5% and window 2 at load 6.2 with a floor of +-1.6%

known_gaps.mulrk_mulblank: MulRk and MulBlank are 60,575 of the corpus's 127,072 cell values and still build an 88-byte CellRecord per packed cell on a query that does not want it; they allocate nothing, so what is left is the enum move and its drop glue
known_gaps.label_savings: Label exists 6 times corpus-wide; its measure path is a correctness obligation, not a saving, and no Label saving is claimed
known_gaps.snapshot_scoped_hint: the brief's snapshot-scoped form of XLS-8 is frozen as a design: StreamChainHint borrows its reader, so a snapshot-resident position needs either a reader-independent value that weakens the documented cannot-cross-readers property or interior mutability on an immutable cross-thread snapshot, which ADR 0005 treats as a clean-value cache needing its own record
known_gaps.hint_records_construction_only: a sheet resumes from the previous sheet's first sector, not from where the previous sheet's scan ended, because only construction records into the hint; litchi-cfb has no way to publish a live cursor's position
known_gaps.allocations: no allocation counter was run; the callgrind malloc/free self costs are the only allocation evidence
known_gaps.file_source: no from_path or range-source leg; every XLS harness source is in memory, so XLS-4's per-string fstat cost stays invisible
known_gaps.corpus_aggregate: the corpus-wide -1.96% of chain links is dominated by two single-sheet fixtures that are 85% of the total; -6.14% over the 96 multi-sheet fixtures is the figure that describes the change
known_gaps.second_cell_same_sheet: the harness's second-cell operation queries two cells of the same worksheet; the brief's second cell on another sheet has no selector and would not have moved, because XLS-8 does not serve repeated queries

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, range-source, peak-RSS, allocation-count, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
